Swift Executive Aptitude-Rx Assessment Report — Dattatreya Vellal
Generated: 27 October 2020
Comparison group: Senior Managers & Executives (INT, IA, 2015) — 590 people

=== TOTAL SCORE ===
Total Score: Average — 62nd percentile
Performed better than 62 percent of the comparison group (Senior Managers & Executives).
Sten scale position: between 6 and 7 (Sten 6 = higher than ~60%; Sten 7 = higher than ~75%)

=== APTITUDE AREA SUB-SCORES ===

Verbal Aptitude: Sten 6 — Average (62nd percentile)
- Likely to find working with verbal information as easy as other people.
- Aptitude 6, Pace 6 — worked at an average pace
- Assesses ability to understand, interpret and evaluate written information

Numerical Aptitude: Sten 6 — Average (58th percentile)
- Likely to find working with numerical information as easy as other people.
- Aptitude 6, Pace 5 — worked at an average pace (slightly slower on numerical)
- Assesses ability to understand, interpret and evaluate numerical data

Abstract Aptitude: Sten 6 — Average (58th percentile)
- Likely to find working with abstract information as easy as other people.
- Aptitude 6, Pace 6 — worked at an average pace
- Assesses ability to understand sequences of patterns and relationships

=== TEST COMPLETION DETAILS ===
Initial Access: 27/10/2020 06:40 GMT
Responses Saved: 27/10/2020 07:12 GMT
Duration: approximately 32 minutes
Language: English (United Kingdom)
Administrator Resets: 0
Candidate Aborts: 0
Time Adjustment: None

=== KEY INTERPRETIVE NOTES ===
- All three aptitude dimensions score at Sten 6 — consistent average profile with no significant peaks or valleys across verbal, numerical, or abstract reasoning
- 62nd percentile overall vs international senior manager/executive norm — solidly in the average range for that peer group
- Slightly slower pace on numerical (Pace 5 vs Pace 6 for verbal and abstract) — consistent with BeTalent Strengths finding of Meticulous (#2) and Evaluative (#3) — takes more care with data
- Consistent pace across verbal and abstract (both Pace 6) — steady, measured approach
- The strong career outcomes and leadership impact in Datta's profile are driven by character, work ethic, and leadership qualities rather than unusually high cognitive aptitude — this is an important calibration point for the digital twin
